- region "Game menus":
  - heading "HOW TO PLAY" [level=1]
  - paragraph: LEFT/RIGHT or D-PAD pages • ENTER / A next • ESC / B back
  - img "Movement path around cover toward an evade position, with a threat ahead."
  - article:
    - heading "MOVE AND SURVIVE" [level=2]
    - paragraph: WASD or left stick moves. Mouse or right stick aims. SPACE / A rolls with a short invulnerability window. Each hero has a passive; read it on the character screen.
